attributes.action: Bank Holiday for Monday 6th July after Englands World Cup game
attributes.additional_details: I have work Monday as do a lot of people, I may not be able to even watch the game with this kick off time. Make it a bank holiday and give the nation a chance to cheer on England at the World cup one more time and forget about work the next day.
attributes.background: Make Monday 6th July a bank holiday so that the country can support the Lads in America

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
